params.name: resize
params.description: True if the form can be resized vertically, False otherwise

params.name: minHeight
params.description: Smallest form height allowed, in pixels

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: Largest form height allowed, in pixels

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the current form's vertical resizing properties (whether resizable, and the allowed min/max height in pixels).

constraints: These properties may have been set in the Form editor (Design mode) or previously in the current process via FORM SET VERTICAL RESIZING.
